en: Points of Controversy (Kathāvatthu) Minor Section (Khuddakaaḍḍhapaṇṇāsaka) Twenty-second Chapter (Bāvīsatimavagga)
Is there anyone who attains final Nibbāna without having abandoned some fetter? Yes.
Is there anyone who attains final Nibbāna without having abandoned any form of personality-view (*sakkāyadiṭṭhi*) ... [and so on] ... without having abandoned lack of moral dread (*anottappa*)?
One should not say so ... [and so on].
Is there anyone who attains final Nibbāna without having abandoned any fetter (*saṁyojana*)?
“Then is an Arahant one who possesses lust … pe … one who has defilements?
You should not speak thus … pe …
Is it not the case that the Arahant is free from lust … [and so on] … free from defilements? Yes.
If the Arahant is indeed free from lust … [and so on] … free from defilements, then surely you should not say:
“Is there any fetter that has not been abandoned for one who attains final Nibbāna?
Is it not to be said:
“There is no fetter that has not been abandoned for one who attains final Nibbāna”?
“Then it must be said that an Arahant knows the entire range of a Buddha’s domain?
"Therefore, there exists some fetter that has not been abandoned for one who attains final nibbāna.
The Discussion on Final Nibbāna is concluded.
